detail.longDescription:
Honorlock helps you complete your authentication steps and use your mobile device as a webcam during supported Honorlock online assessments. This app walks you through each step before your session begins, then securely connects your phone's camera to your session.

This app does not deliver sessions or provide proctoring itself. It works alongside your institution's Honorlock enabled assessments.

Features

- Guided, step-by-step Honorlock authentication
- Use your phone's camera as a webcam
- ID, workspace, and camera setup in one place
- Saved progress so an interruption won't make you start over
- Compatible with supported Honorlock enabled assessments
